tasks.label: Dev: Health Check
args: try { $front = (Invoke-WebRequest -UseBasicParsing -Uri 'http://localhost:3000/login').StatusCode } catch { $front = 'DOWN' }; try { $back = (Invoke-WebRequest -UseBasicParsing -Uri 'http://localhost:3001/auth/login' -Method POST -ContentType 'application/json' -Body '{"email":"athlete@test.com","password":"123456"}').StatusCode } catch { if ($_.Exception.Response) { $back = $_.Exception.Response.StatusCode.value__ } else { $back = 'DOWN' } }; Write-Output "frontend=$front backend_login=$back"

tasks.label: Dev: Stop Full Stack
args: $ports = @(3000, 3001); foreach ($port in $ports) { $connections = Get-NetTCPConnection -LocalPort $port -State Listen -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; if ($connections) { $owningPids = $connections | Select-Object -ExpandProperty OwningProcess -Unique; foreach ($procId in $owningPids) { Stop-Process -Id $procId -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue }; Write-Output "stopped port=$port pids=$($owningPids -join ',')" } else { Write-Output "no listener on port=$port" } }
